theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) mixed with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy). A premium, cinematic dark mode infused with warm analog/vinyl textures to evoke high-end audio equipment.
core_principles: Dark-first design: Build natively for OLED blacks and deep shadows.
Analog Warmth: Avoid generic tech blue/purple; use warm amber and terracotta accents.
Bento/Grid Layouts: Use modular cards with glassmorphism for library and controls.
Mobile-First Constraints: Emulate a React Native mobile app layout using a constrained max-width container (e.g. max-w-md mx-auto h-screen) with bottom tab navigation.

background.description: Deep obsidian black for the root mobile app background.

surface.description: Milled glassmorphism for cards, mini-player, and bottom nav. Must always have a 1px border.

accent.description: Warm glowing amber representing vacuum tubes and analog energy. Used for play buttons, active tabs, and sliders.

rules.general: No generic sans like Inter. Keep text readable in dark mode (APCA contrast). Never center everything—align left for track lists.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden flex flex-col relative bg-neutral-950 border-x border-white/5 shadow-2xl
layout_patterns: Bottom Tab Navigation: Fixed at the bottom, above safe area, glassmorphic.
Mini Player: Floating directly above the bottom nav, stretches full width of container minus padding.
Scrollable Content: Flex-1 container with overflow-y-auto hidden scrollbar.
Full Screen Player: Absolute inset-0 z-50 covering everything with a slide-up animation feel.

auth_screen.layout: Full-height image background with heavy bottom-up gradient mask (bg-gradient-to-t from-neutral-950 via-neutral-950/80 to-transparent).
auth_screen.form: Glassmorphic bento card (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-neutral-900/40 border border-white/10).
auth_screen.inputs: Shadcn Inputs heavily customized: bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white rounded-xl h-12 px-4 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500.
auth_screen.button: Primary CTA rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-neutral-950 font-bold h-12.

library_screen.header: Search input for Suno Username. Glassmorphic styling with a subtle search icon on left.
library_screen.recently_played: Horizontal carousel (flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 scrollbar-hide). Square cards w/ rounded-xl art, 140x140px, bold 1-line title, small artist name.
library_screen.public_songs_list: Vertical list. Each row: flex flex-row items-center gap-4 py-2. Left: 56x56px rounded-md artwork. Center: flex-1 flex-col truncate title & tags. Right: text-xs duration & play count. Play button appears on hover/active.

mini_player.container: absolute bottom-[70px] left-2 right-2 h-16 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 flex items-center px-3 z-40 shadow-xl overflow-hidden cursor-pointer
mini_player.elements: Thumbnail (40x40px rounded-sm), scrolling title marquee, play/pause button (amber), absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-[2px] bg-amber-500 (progress bar representing time).

full_screen_player.container: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-neutral-950 flex flex-col p-6 (within the mobile container width).
full_screen_player.artwork: Massive square artwork (w-full aspect-square rounded-2xl shadow-2xl shadow-amber-900/20 mb-8).
full_screen_player.info: Large bold track title, artist name underneath.
full_screen_player.seek_bar: Custom slider: 1px high track (bg-white/20), thick active track (bg-amber-500). Thumb should be small or invisible until pressed.
full_screen_player.controls: Flex row justify-between items-center mt-6. Large 64x64px circular play/pause button (bg-amber-500 text-black). Subdued skip/shuffle/repeat icons.

bottom_navigation.container: absolute bottom-0 w-full h-[64px] bg-neutral-900/90 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-white/5 flex justify-around items-center z-30
bottom_navigation.items: 3-4 tabs (Library, Search, Favorites, Profile). Active state gets an amber-500 subtle glow/tint.

motion.hover: Transition-all duration-300 ease-out. Active items scale-95.
motion.list_items: Staggered fade-up on mount for library songs.
motion.page_transitions: Slide-up for Now Playing full screen, fade for tab switching.

auth_hero.description: Analog vacuum tube hi-fi amp for the login background.

empty_state.description: Floating vinyl with neon waves for empty library state.

albums.description: Red, blue, and green figure (Track artwork)
Dynamic red and blue swirls (Track artwork)

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons with 'fill' weight for active states and 'regular' for inactive states. Install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK RULE: The user asked for a 'React Native Expo' app, but our environment is React JS, Tailwind, and Shadcn. YOU MUST build a responsive web application that visually mimics a mobile app.
Wrap the main App content in a 'max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden relative shadow-2xl bg-neutral-950' to force a mobile-sized viewport on desktop, making it feel exactly like a mobile app.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for fonts. Import 'Outfit' (headings) and 'Manrope' (body) via Google Fonts.
Implement the Mini Player so it sticks to the bottom above the tab navigation. Clicking it should expand to the full screen Now Playing view (absolute inset-0 z-50).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='play-pause-btn').
Never use placehold.it. Use the assets provided in this JSON.
For the audio player logic, mock it if necessary but ensure the UI visually supports play/pause/skip/seek/shuffle states.
